description: This file defines a Python service class 'EvidenceService' for creating, storing, and retrieving evidence packages associated with data assets. It includes functionality for generating cryptographic hashes, assembling evidence artifacts, storing manifests, and ensuring integrity of stored evidence. It also has custom exception handling and integrates with a database and audit service.

classes.name: EvidenceError
classes.description: Custom exception class for evidence-related errors, capturing an error code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: EvidenceService
classes.description: Main service class providing methods to create and retrieve evidence packages, including generating hashes, storing manifests, and auditing actions.
